import math

# Budget expenditures (column 3), in millions, for available months in range Mar 1942 - Oct 1948
# Only monthly data from 1947-Jan onward is provided; restricting to <= 1948-October
exp = {
    "1947-Jan": 3019.0, "1947-Feb": 3731.0, "1947-Mar": 3839.0, "1947-Apr": 3407.0,
    "1947-May": 3284.0, "1947-Jun": 4996.0, "1947-Jul": 3553.0, "1947-Aug": 2962.0,
    "1947-Sep": 2673.0, "1947-Oct": 2394.0, "1947-Nov": 2113.0, "1947-Dec": 3176.0,
    "1948-Jan": 2800.0, "1948-Feb": 2224.0, "1948-Mar": 3086.0, "1948-Apr": 2512.0,
    "1948-May": 2222.0, "1948-Jun": 7018.0, "1948-Jul": 3558.0, "1948-Aug": 2143.0,
    "1948-Sep": 2869.0, "1948-Oct": 2685.0,
}

vals = list(exp.values())
log_sum = sum(math.log(v) for v in vals)
gm = math.exp(log_sum / len(vals))
print(round(gm, 2))
